question: Does Kottelat's 2013 inland-fish catalogue independently document Simulao stream and the MNHN type series, and does it resolve the museum's 'lag.limao' locality field?

catalogue.citation: Kottelat, M. (2013). The fishes of the inland waters of Southeast Asia: A catalogue and core bibliography of the fishes known to occur in freshwaters, mangroves and estuaries. The Raffles Bulletin of Zoology, Supplement 27, 1-663. Published 22 November 2013.
catalogue.entryTextSummary: Under Barbodes montanoi, the catalogue gives the type locality as Philippines: Mindanao: Simulao stream; it lists syntypes MNHN 3398 [1, listed as holotype] and 3399 [12], citing Bertin & Estève (1948: 29).
catalogue.interpretation: This is an independently reviewable taxonomic catalogue that corroborates the historical Simulao stream name and shows how earlier MNHN type labels were reported. It does not provide a specimen coordinate or reconcile the MNHN object-record field 'lag.limao'.

crossSourceComparison.kottelat2013: Simulao stream; syntypes MNHN 3398 [1, listed as holotype] and 3399 [12].
crossSourceComparison.huiHusana2021: Simulao River in central Mindanao; treats the 13 original specimens collectively as syntypes under its ICZN Article 72.1 argument.
crossSourceComparison.baliscoLiao2025: Simulao River, tributary of Agusan; lists A-3398 as holotype and A-3399 as 12 paratypes, noting the 2021 syntype interpretation.
crossSourceComparison.mnhnIndexedObjectRecords: Mindanao and waterbody string 'lag.limao'; no river name or coordinates in the indexed fields reviewed. Direct page open was unavailable.
crossSourceComparison.result: Three taxonomic publications/catalogues identify Simulao stream/river as the historical type locality, with differences in type-status treatment. The museum object metadata locality string remains unresolved and cannot be converted into an exact site or geometry.

rightsAndAccess.access: The full 2013 catalogue PDF is hosted by Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum. Its Digital Gems repository record marks the item Open Access; the PDF front matter states copyright National University of Singapore and the author. No specific Creative Commons license was verified.
rightsAndAccess.reuse: No PDF pages, tables or images were copied. This repository stores concise attribution and factual research notes only; public-app reproduction or reuse is not approved by this review.

limits: A taxonomic catalogue's type-locality entry is historical evidence and does not establish current occupancy, abundance or river-wide distribution.
The 2013 catalogue does not independently interpret the MNHN field 'lag.limao' or supply a coordinate crosswalk.
The 2013 catalogue and museum labels are not treated as adjudicating Hui and Husana's 2021 nomenclatural argument.
The source does not support natural diet, bait, fishing access, legal catchability, safety, water quality, conservation status or waterbody geometry.

references.supports: Full 2013 catalogue and the Barbodes montanoi type-locality/type-series entry.
Repository bibliographic record, publisher, date and Open Access access-status label.
MNHN object record used only to compare its indexed Mindanao/'lag.limao' fields; direct open was unavailable.

nextAction: Continue Caraga freshwater coverage by seeking a primary fish survey or independently cataloged specimen record from a different named river, lake or marsh. Keep Simulao as a historical type-locality lead until a source resolves the MNHN 'lag.limao' string or supplies defensible locality coordinates.
